automation.notes: Use button: choose this kit's Skill and Specialization first. Automatic: when a roll calls for that kit, the Roll Options Dialog says so; with it, Standard kit rolls take no Snag, Limited ones ↓1 and Restricted ones ↓3. Use button: use it up for 1 minute of that Specialization (or ↑1 if already Specialized), shown as a labelled source when you roll, or scrounge a refill.
